show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/HCtCWG
show.description: A poor delivery boy named Romeo suddenly gains the extraordinary ability to see people’s lifespan and the true value of things, a power that changes his destiny overnight. When he saves Saloni, a wealthy heiress caught in a dangerous inheritance battle, he is pulled into a high-stakes world of money, power, and betrayal.
